Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable headset MIC of ASUS X430UN and X512DK with ALC256

The ASUS X430UN and X512DK with ALC256 cannot detect the headset MIC
until ALC256_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
